target.title: fix(supervisor): suppress unhandled stream errors on child stdout/stderr
target.body:
## Summary

Add noop error listeners on `child.stdout` and `child.stderr` in the core process supervisor to prevent unhandled stream error crashes.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

**Behavior addressed**: The supervisor adapter registers `data`, `end`, and `close` listeners on child process stdout/stderr streams but no `error` handler. If either stream emits an error (EPIPE, I/O failure, resource limit), Node throws an unhandled `error` event and crashes the gateway worker. All `supervisor.spawn()` calls flow through this adapter.

**Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, OpenClaw main

**Exact steps run after this patch**:
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/process/supervisor/adapters/child.test.ts
```

**Evidence after fix**:
```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  19 passed (19)
```

The new test "suppresses stream errors on stdout and stderr" creates a stub child via `createStubChild`, subscribes to stdout/stderr via `adapter.onStdout()`/`adapter.onStderr()` (which installs the error handlers), then emits errors on both streams. The `expect(...).not.toThrow()` assertion proves the errors are suppressed.

**Before-fix evidence**: `child.stdout.on("error")` and `child.stderr.on("error")` were absent. Node PassThrough streams emit `error` events; without a registered listener, `stream.emit("error", err)` throws synchronously.

**Observed result after fix**: Stream error events on stdout/stderr are silently suppressed. Data/end/close events continue to work normally.

**What was not tested**: Live EPIPE on a real child process stdout pipe (requires OS-level pipe manipulation). The test directly emits error events on PassThrough streams to verify the handler is installed.

## Risk

Low. Two one-line noop handlers. Same pattern already used for `child.stdin` in `src/process/exec.ts:613`.
